FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Have a question? Find quick answers below, or contact us directly for anything specific.

General

What is Arada Tech?

Arada Tech is a software development company headquartered in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We design and build custom websites, web applications, mobile apps, custom business software, and UI/UX for organizations in Ethiopia and internationally.

Who is the CEO of Arada Tech?

Tinsae Mesfin is the chief executive of Arada Tech. The company was founded in 2016 and operates from Bole Atlas, Addis Ababa.

What services does Arada Tech offer?

We offer website development, web application development, mobile app development (iOS and Android), custom software development, and UI/UX design services. Our team handles everything from initial concept and design through development, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

Where is Arada Tech located?

We are based in Bole Atlas, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. While our office is in Addis Ababa, we work with clients across Ethiopia and internationally.

How long has Arada Tech been in business?

Arada Tech was founded in 2016. We have over 10 years of experience delivering software solutions for businesses across multiple industries in Ethiopia.

Projects & Process

How long does a typical project take?

Project timelines depend on complexity. A simple website typically takes 4 to 6 weeks. Web applications range from 8 to 16 weeks. Mobile apps take 8 to 20 weeks. Custom software projects vary based on scope. We provide detailed timelines during the proposal phase.

What is your development process?

We follow a four phase process: Discovery (understanding your business needs), Design (creating wireframes and visual designs), Development (building and testing iteratively), and Deployment & Support (launching and maintaining your product). We provide regular updates throughout.

Do you provide project estimates before starting?

Yes. After an initial consultation where we understand your requirements, we provide a detailed proposal with scope, timeline, and pricing. This consultation is free and comes with no obligation.

Can I see progress during development?

Absolutely. We believe in transparency. You will receive regular progress updates, and we set up staging environments where you can review the work at every milestone before we proceed.

Technical

What technologies do you work with?

We work with modern technologies including React, Next.js, Astro, Node.js, Python, React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, and more. We choose the best technology stack for each project based on your specific requirements.

Do you handle hosting and deployment?

Yes. We can help you choose the right hosting solution, set everything up, and manage deployment. We work with shared hosting, VPS, cloud providers (AWS, Google Cloud), and other hosting environments.

Can you integrate with existing systems?

Yes. We regularly build solutions that integrate with existing databases, APIs, ERP systems, payment gateways, and third party services. We design clean APIs to ensure seamless integration.

Do you provide ongoing maintenance and support?

Yes. We offer maintenance and support packages that include bug fixes, security updates, performance monitoring, and feature enhancements. We are committed to keeping your software running smoothly after launch.

Pricing & Payments

How much does a project cost?

Costs vary based on project complexity, features, and timeline. We provide detailed proposals after understanding your needs. We work with businesses of all sizes and can find solutions that fit your budget. Contact us for a free consultation and estimate.

What are your payment terms?

We typically structure payments in milestones: an initial deposit to begin work, progress payments at key milestones, and a final payment upon project completion. This protects both parties and aligns incentives.

Do you offer any guarantees?

Yes. We provide a warranty period after launch during which we fix any bugs at no additional cost. We also offer satisfaction guarantees: we work with you until you are happy with the result.

Still Have Questions?

We're happy to help. Get in touch and we'll respond within 24 hours.
